description: Generates Huawei Cloud pre-order estimates, provisions allowlisted resources through hcloud, and routes unsubscribe requests to console guidance. Use for Huawei Cloud pricing, budgets, creation, provisioning, or unsubscribe. Creates require runtime help, --dryrun, fee review, and confirmation. Never emits or runs unsubscribe operations, accepts credentials, or performs non-allowlisted writes.
